source: If those two statements stay together, most ZXNAME0000XZ claims become easier to evaluate. The architecture is neither “a giant model for the price of a tiny one” nor merely “several FFNs with a router.” It is a co-design problem
zh: 如果这两个陈述结合在一起，大多数 ZXNAME0000XZ 声明就会变得更容易评估。该架构既不是“用小模型换取巨大模型”，也不仅仅是“带有路由器的多个 FFN”。这是一个协同设计问题
